serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Policewoman: Still alive? That was a lot of stopping power, you know?
Policewoman: I guess I can tell you this much. 
Policewoman: It’s just a job, kid. You should have stayed silent about it.
Policewoman: But I gotta say, you are one unlucky bastard. Of all the police officers to report this thing to, you ended up coming to me.
Policewoman: Oh and don’t worry about your hobo friend. There are cameras everywhere these days. One of them for sure caught him. We will pay him a visit later.
You: Why… did you kill her…
Policewoman: It wasn’t me.
Policewoman: As far as I know, some new guy was picking up the bot. There was some trouble and the girl had to go.
Policewoman: I would chat a little more, but now I have this whole mess to clean up. I don’t want my stupid partner to suspect anything.
Policewoman: No hard feelings.
